Ibrahim: Quick flag - bringing up Merchantly's LoRA. Small but repeatable numeric drift after int4 packing: cents change by a few hundredths. FP16 baseline fine.

Clara: do you have the quickpack snippet and quant profile used?

Ibrahim: Ran standard quickpack: ./evalpack/run_quickpack.sh --model merchantly-base-fp16 --adapter merchantly-v2.lora --quant q4_0 --prompts tests/merchantly/invoices.jsonl. Sample lines: {id:inv-12 fp16:12.34 q4:12.31 d:-0.03}, {id:inv-45 fp16:0.00 q4:0.02 d:+0.02}. Full artifacts on s3.

Jules: first triage: tokenization around digits/punctuation, plus check logits pre-softmax. Can you save tokens+logits for ~25 failing examples?

Ibrahim: re-run with --save-tokens --save-logits, uploaded to s3://redwood-evals/merchantly/quickpack/6887654321/logs.

ci-bot: Adapter signature/metadata scan passed.

Pat: quick glance at logits: q4 shows consistent negative shift on last-digit logits (-0.2 to -0.4) vs fp16 on multiple samples. That aligns with lower emitted digits.

Clara: try two experiments: A) merge LoRA into fp16 then quantize, B) q4_aw asymmetric quant profile. Also try disabling kv-cache warmstart as a control.

Ibrahim: queued merged->quant and q4_aw runs. Also added a targeted 100-sample numeric pack varying separators, currencies, magnitudes. Will run overnight and attach results.

Jules: if merged->quant reduces failures, recommend merged rollout for money endpoints. Also add a short prompt mitigation: system instruction "Return amounts as MM.DD with exactly two decimals and leading $" to reduce customer impact.

Pat: add canary rule: block q4 rollout if >4% of numeric pack samples exceed abs_delta 0.02.

Ibrahim: noted. Will drop a remediation note for Merchantly with options: merged-then-quant, q4_aw profile, or keep fp16 for billing-critical paths. Tagging @jules @clara for follow-up. :coffee:
